Name: Gedaliah, Son of Ahikam
Summary: Gedaliah, son of Ahikam, was made governor over Judah's remnant by Nebuchadnezzar, gathered the scattered captains at Mizpah, and was murdered by Ishmael son of Nethaniah in the seventh month.
KeyStory: Gedaliah governs the remnant and is murdered.
RelatedPeople: King Nebuchadnezzar; Ahikam, Son of Shaphan; Ishmael, Son of Nethaniah; Johanan, Son of Careah
LifeLesson: A governor who trusted too easily died for the remnant's last hope.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
